exceptions.finding: Harvest Kona is square-shoulder only, so its field uses square-shoulder boards. MAX (1.5 in) boards exist only for Vintage Coastline and Harvest Slate Gray; the standard 1x6 stays the default.
Matching fascia and riser exist for every collection color (Advanced PVC 0.50 x 11.75 fascia, 0.75 x 7.25 riser; composite 0.575 x 11.95 fascia, 0.575 x 7.25 riser). Standard applies fully.
Square-shoulder boards exist in every color, so picture frames and treads work in main or frame color. Advanced PVC stairs: top-down fastening on square-shoulder only.
Advanced PVC boards are 1.0 in thick and composite 0.94 in (Premier/Premier+ 0.89 in). Mixing PVC and composite, or Premier with other composites, for a contrast frame creates a height difference.
exceptions.salesBehavior: Offer same-material contrast first; flag cross-material contrast for technical review.
